stones.minimal_witness: One blind black man shouting in the crowd and tapping his cane on cobblestones.
stones.redundant_memory: Many blind black men shouting and tapping canes in polyrhythm across Zirma's cobblestones.

stones.minimal_witness: One lunatic leaning out and teetering on a single skyscraper's high cornice.
stones.redundant_memory: In every skyscraper someone going mad; lunatics teetering for hours along rows of dizzying cornices.

stones.minimal_witness: One girl walking with a single puma on a leash.
stones.redundant_memory: Girls walking pumas raised on a whim on taut leashes all along the colonnades.

stones.minimal_witness: Companions swear they saw only one dirigible hovering high among the city's spires.
stones.redundant_memory: Dirigibles flying in all directions at window level across skyscraper facades.

stones.minimal_witness: Companions swear they saw only one tattoo artist arranging needles, inks, and pierced patterns on his bench.
stones.redundant_memory: Streets of crowded shops drawing tattoos of anchors, serpents, and stars onto sailors' skin.

stones.minimal_witness: Companions swear they saw only one fat woman fanning herself on an empty train platform.
stones.redundant_memory: Underground trains crammed window-to-window with obese women suffering and fanning in thick humidity.

calvino_source.inner_arch: Both the city and memory are redundant—repeating signs over and over (or multiplying singular sightings in recollection) so that something sticks in the mind and the city can begin to exist.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Stereoscopic witness-discrepancy & typographic woodblock/rotogravure stamp-overprint press
anti_trude_vector.aesthetic: Dampened rag-cotton press sheet (#f2ebdc), lampblack carbon (#151311), Prussian litho ink (#183046), sailor-tattoo vermilion (#a82e24), dirigible brass ochre (#b6822b), subterranean steam verdigris (#2c574f)
anti_trude_vector.causal_law: Singular testimony evaporates rapidly toward non-existence (ghost alpha < 0.08 within seconds); only repeating a sign—via Polo's redundant memory pole, repeated clicks, or overprint stamping—multiplies the motif and deposits indelible multi-pass ink registration onto the permanent press plate so Zirma begins to exist.

epistemic_partition.rule: Strict mutual blindness between witness and multiplier builders.

royal-plate-guild.note: Delivered by Coordinator Royal Plate Guilds per #113

methods.createState(): Returns mutable witness state tracking fading visibility [0..1] per stone, perceptual tremor phase, and solitary figure coordinates
methods.sightPulse(state, stoneId): Momentarily raises stone visibility to ~0.88 for a fleeting singular witness claim before rapid exponential decay resumes
methods.step(state, dt, params): Advances decay & subtle uncertain drift; params = { reducedMotion: boolean, witnessWeight: number, stonePermanence: Record<string, number>, activeStone: string|null }
methods.render(ctx, width, height, state, params: Renders sparse 1-instance graphite/sepia architectural cues and strictly ONE instance per stone, fading toward vanishing as visibility drops
methods.getTestimonyCaption(stoneId): Returns concise Companions' sworn 1-instance testimony string
methods.getAudioCue(stoneId): Returns WebAudio synthesis descriptor { type, freq, duration, gain, timbre } for a lonely single acoustic event

methods.createState(): Returns mutable swarming state with flocks of window-level dirigibles, cornice figures on every spire, cane-tapping chorus, multiple leashed pumas, bustling sailor tattoo street, packed humid subway cars, and stamp counts
methods.step(state, dt, params): Advances swarming motion (or static woodblock registration when params.reducedMotion is true); params = { reducedMotion: boolean, swarmWeight: number, stonePermanence: Record<string, number>, activeStone: string|null }
methods.stampStone(state, stoneId, stampCtx, wid: Draws an indelible woodblock/rotogravure multi-instance ink overprint pass (with slight registration offset in Prussian/vermilion/ochre/lampblack) directly onto persistent offscreen stampCtx for stoneId; increments stamp count and returns { stoneId, stamps, permanenceDelta }
methods.renderLive(ctx, width, height, state, pa: Renders live kinetic/overprinted swarming multitudes across all 6 stones weighted by swarmWeight and stonePermanence
methods.getMemoryCaption(stoneId): Returns concise Polo redundant memory string for stoneId
methods.getPolyrhythmCues(stoneId, density): Returns array of WebAudio synthesis descriptors for interlocking polyrhythmic cane taps, buzzing tattoo needles, window-level dirigible hum, puma stride, cornice wind, and subway fan/rail chorus

frozen_gates.HG-1: Standalone, Archival Plates & Anti-Trude Structural Gate: charter.json, index.html, map.svg (1600x1200), map.png (1600x1200 valid PNG, high variance), image.png (1600x1000 valid PNG, rich variance), and dossier.json exist; index.html includes an inspectable <plate-folio> Map & City Plate drawer displaying local map.png and image.png; zero http/https external URLs; zero '../' strings anywhere in index.html; bespoke <zirma-*> custom tag paths and .zrm-* CSS selectors yielding J_dom < 0.35; zero syntax or runtime errors.
frozen_gates.HG-2: Calvino Fidelity & Causal Existence Gate: All 6 Zirma stones rendered with unmistakable visual silhouettes in both poles; Companions' Minimalist Testimony shows strictly 1 instance per stone that actively decays toward invisibility unless repeated; Polo's Redundant Memory and stamp-overprinting multiply instances and deposit indelible ink onto the permanent press plate so repetition literally brings Zirma into existence.
frozen_gates.HG-3: Viewport, Keyboard & Motion Gate: Clean layout with zero overlap/clipping at both 1280x800 desktop and 390x844 mobile; full keyboard operation (1-6 stone focus/stamp, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight stereoscope blend, Space overprint pass, M audio mute, R wash plate); prefers-reduced-motion respected.
